remarks: Rare opportunity for investors and developers in downtown Stamford. This legally established two-family residence (Land Use Code 104: 2-Family Residence) sits on a 3,500 sq. ft. lot zoned R5, offering a solid income-producing or value-add foundation. The property offers 2,204 sq. ft. of living area (3,236 sq. ft. gross) across two stories, with 6 bedrooms, 2 full bathrooms, and 12 total rooms split between two units. Combination-fuel hot water baseboard heat, per town assessor records. The home is being offered as-is, an excellent candidate for renovation, repositioning as a two-unit rental, or redevelopment. Motivated seller.
